basis: Individually read official evidence in frozen source-label adjudications; historical person data unchanged.

changes.name: Université Bordeaux I
changes.evidence: Fully opened current Université de Bordeaux official history says Bordeaux 1 persisted as science/technology institution after a 1995 split, then Bordeaux 1, Bordeaux Segalen and Montesquieu Bordeaux IV merged into the new Université de Bordeaux effective 1 January 2014. Retain the exact OM List historical doctorate label and its award date; do not present Bordeaux I as a separate concurrent current university or rewrite an individual's degree issuer without checking the original credential.

changes.name: University of Bordeaux IV
changes.evidence: Fully opened official current university history identifies Université Bordeaux IV Montesquieu as the post-1995 law/social-sciences/economics/management institution and one of the three universities merged into the new Université de Bordeaux effective 1 January 2014. The imported reported doctorate is dated 2013, so its historical Bordeaux IV label should remain intact while linking to the current successor identity; it is not an additional concurrent provider.

changes.name: University of Aix-Marseille II
changes.evidence: Fully opened official 2011 financial report names Université de la Méditerranée (Aix-Marseille II) explicitly and says its last year was 2011 because it merged with the other two universities into Université d'Aix-Marseille on 1 January 2012. The current Aix-Marseille Université site independently confirms the 2012 three-university merger. Preserve the imported reported 2008 doctorate's historical institution wording and connect it to current successor identity; do not create a duplicate current provider.

changes.name: University Pierre Mendès France of Grenoble
changes.evidence: Fully opened UGA 2021–26 official institutional contract identifies Université Pierre-Mendès-France as one of three predecessors merged into Université Grenoble Alpes in 2016. The OM List entry labels a doctorate from Pierre Mendès France with year 2018, two years after the predecessor ceased as an independent university. This establishes a real predecessor/successor identity but a conflict in that individual's reported label/year; preserve the original imported facts, do not relabel the degree to UGA or treat the historic school as a current duplicate provider.

changes.name: École des Mines de Nantes
changes.evidence: Official current school mission page identifies the 1 January 2017 merger of Mines Nantes and Télécom Bretagne into IMT Atlantique. Historical predecessor label retained with the imported 2009 doctorate; this display lineage does not rewrite the degree issuer or verify the individual award.

changes.name: Mohammadia School of Engineers
changes.evidence: The fully opened official École Mohammadia d'Ingénieurs governance page explicitly identifies the school as affiliated with Université Mohammed V de Rabat. Its current governance list identifies a Département Génie Industriel. The full EMI doctoral cycle page confirms doctorate supervision and thesis defense at the school. This imported school label should be associated with the existing university provider, not added as another independent university or duplicate doctoral route.

changes.name: Geneva School of Economics and Management
changes.evidence: Official GSEM Management doctorate page identifies the University of Geneva as degree awarder and GSEM as its school. Associate the source school label with its university for discovery and display; no relevant doctorate or individual degree is inferred.
